decisions.reason: The polymer concrete housing had its own page in both years and fits the firm's compatible product families, so its results appear to meet aspiration and it supports the core drain business.
Floor-level shower drainage moved from a mention to its own page, which signals rising importance in line with the firm's strategic direction, so there is no shortfall to prompt search.

The flagship designer drain dropped from its own page to a mention, a mild sign of shortfall, but its central role in the design-conscious positioning and the firm's slack as an established specialist justify keeping it.
The sloped shower element was only ever mentioned, suggesting modest results, yet it complements the floor-level shower range at low incremental cost, so management is likely to keep it.
The DallSafe backflow cellar drain advanced to the home page, indicating results above aspiration in a growing flood-protection market.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral, only-mentioned accessory with uncertain performance, but it rounds out the drainage system offering cheaply, so it is retained for now.
